messages:
Elena Park: Kicking off a relnotes + migration guide draft for the runtime change: batching presets + KV-cache improvements. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5420
Samir Desai: Thanks. Can you paste TL;DR bullets here so I can copyedit and add SDK examples?
Elena Park: TL;DR bullets: 1) New presets: interactive-low-latency, throughput-balanced, cost-saver-1. 2) KV cache: reduced mem footprint + improved prefix reuse. 3) Router preference now leans to same-region replicas to lower p99. 4) Known issue: canary dashboards may briefly underreport latency during prefix warmup/eviction windows.
Hannah Lee: For migration guide: include a short checklist for customers migrating from custom batching to presets (staging test, smoke p95/p99, enable via route config, restart long-lived workers). I'll author the guide section.
Samir Desai: I'll add SDK snippets for Python, Node, and Go. Draft Python snippet:
```
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
c.routes.update('checkout-flow', batching_preset='interactive-low-latency')
```
Node snippet:
```
// node
await client.routes.update('checkout-flow', { batchingPreset: 'interactive-low-latency' })
```
Go snippet draft:
```
// go
client := redwood.NewClient()
client.Routes.Update("checkout-flow", redwood.RouteUpdate{BatchingPreset: "interactive-low-latency"})
```
Elena Park: Great — add a tiny note in each snippet about expected effect and link to the API reference. Also include a dedicated example for pinning a preset at pool level and mention process recycle.
Gabe Ortiz: Known issues wording suggestion: "Enabling presets on legacy routes can cause transient p50/p95 spikes (1-3 minutes) while continuous-batch windows and KV caches rebalance. Canary dashboards may underreport latency during this period." Also link to incident tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2580
Hannah Lee: For migration guide I'll add an example pool config: `poolConfig: { batchingPreset: 'throughput-balanced' }` and an ops note: "Restart or recycle GPU workers to pick up the new preset; long-running processes won't pick it up automatically."
docs-robot: Reminder: add a whats-new markdown under /docs/whats-new with frontmatter. Suggested frontmatter:
```
---
date: 2025-06-20
title: "Batching presets & KV cache improvements"
components: [runtime, routing]
---
```
Samir Desai: I'll drop the SDK snippets into the PR and add anchors for the migration guide sections. Also will add a short code comment about no breaking API changes.
Elena Park: Can someone run a quick link-check sweep for any SDK/reference links that need updating? There were a couple stale anchors last release.
Gabe Ortiz: I'll run the link linter and fix any broken anchors in the migration guide (if found) before merge.
Hannah Lee: QA checklist I'll add to the PR: 1) smoke test in staging 2) run p99 ramp script 3) monitor canary dashboard for 20 minutes post-merge 4) validate dedicated pool preset behavior.
Elena Park: Any objections to merging once docs edits + link fixes + CI are green? Plan: merge and schedule whats-new publish tomorrow 09:00 PST, ping eng-oncall at merge for 30m of monitoring.
Samir Desai: No objections. I'll wait for Gabe's link check and then push the snippets.
Gabe Ortiz: Link linter finished: two stale anchors fixed, one redirect added. Ready for final review.
Elena Park: Perfect. Merging after CI then. Thanks everyone :rocket:
